toolsPreview.name: search_site
toolsPreview.description: Search built2winweb.com and get an answer. Ranks 167 service, industry and blog pages and answers straight from the site's own FAQ content when there is a confident match, otherwise returns the best matching pages with snippets. Tolerates misspellings. Use this first for any specific question about what BuiltToWinWeb does or how it works.

toolsPreview.name: list_offerings
toolsPreview.description: List all service pages and all industry pages the site covers, with URLs. Use this to check whether a particular business type or service is supported.

toolsPreview.name: request_quote
toolsPreview.description: Submit a project quote request to BuiltToWinWeb. This sends a real enquiry, so only call it once the user has explicitly asked for a quote and supplied their own name and email. Returns a reference number on success.

toolsPreview.name: get_services
toolsPreview.description: What BuiltToWinWeb builds: custom hand-coded PHP websites for small businesses (restaurants, law firms, dentists, contractors, salons, ecommerce, SaaS). Returns the service list with links.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: BuiltToWinWeb pricing: flat one-time fee, no monthly costs, full code ownership. Exact quotes are per-project via the free quote form.

toolsPreview.name: get_contact
toolsPreview.description: How to contact BuiltToWinWeb or request a free project quote.

toolsPreview.name: get_page_markdown
toolsPreview.description: Fetches any page on built2winweb.com and returns it converted to Markdown (uses the site's markdown content negotiation). Pass the path, e.g. "/" or "/blog/core-web-vitals/".
